artifacts.summary: 8-phase implementation plan (~10.5h) for the postflight deploy gate: shared freshness library, check-only exit-6 backstop in update-task-status.sh, regression suite, two serialized baseline-relative deploy triggers, the mandatory carve-out, and a deploy/self-demonstration phase.

memory_candidates.content: When adding a new refusal branch to a shared bash chokepoint script, verify the exit-code allocation by execution rather than by taking the highest documented code and adding one. scripts/update-task-status.sh documents codes 0-4 prominently in its header usage block but also uses exit 5 twice, deep in the file, for missing-shared-library environment errors -- a research pass that read only the header recommended 5 for a new gate and would have collided. Run `grep -nE 'exit [0-9]' <script>` over the whole file and enumerate distinct codes before allocating.
